description_en: Synchronizes an intra-city car service approval form
kebab_example: aliyun btripopen car-apply-add --third-part-apply-id IRGS1413 --title '访问客户' --cause '访问客户' --status 0 --user-id OPEN1415614 --api-version 2022-05-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CarApplyAdd

parameters.help_en: The ID of the third-party approval form
parameters.name: third_part_apply_id

parameters.help_en: The title of the approval form
parameters.name: title

parameters.help_en: The reason for the business trip
parameters.name: cause

parameters.help_en:
The type of available usage count for the approval form. Valid values:

1: Unlimited count.
2: User-specified count.

If your enterprise does not need to limit the usage count of approval forms, set this parameter to 1 (unlimited count) and set both times_total and times_used to 0
parameters.help_zh: 审批单可用次数类型：1:次数不限制 2、用户可指定次数；如果企业没有限制审批单使用次数的需求，这个参数传1(次数不限制)，同时times_total和times_used都传0即可
parameters.name: times_type

parameters.help_en: The total available count for the approval form
parameters.name: times_total

parameters.help_en: The used count for the approval form
parameters.name: times_used

parameters.help_en:
The car service cities. Separate multiple cities with Chinese commas (，).
Note: You can specify up to 10 cities. The values of city and city_code_set must correspond one-to-one
parameters.help_zh:
用车城市，多个城市请用中文“，”隔开。
注意：最多传10个城市，city和city_code_set必须一一对应
parameters.name: city

parameters.help_en:
The set of city codes for intra-city car service. Separate multiple cities with Chinese commas (，).
Note: 1) Either city_code_set or city is required. If both are specified, city_code_set takes precedence.
You can specify up to 10 cities
parameters.help_zh:
市内用车城市code集合，多个城市请用中文“，”隔开。
注意：1)city_code_set和city必填一个，两者都有值默认以city_code_set为准
最多传10个城市
parameters.name: city_code_set

fields.help_en:
The cross-city city code. Only 6-digit codes are supported. Separate multiple values with Chinese commas.
Note: You can specify up to 10 cities. The values of city_code and city_name must correspond one-to-one
fields.help_zh:
跨城城市code，仅支持填写6位code，多值中文逗号分隔
注意：最多传10个城市，city_code和city_name必须一一对应
fields.name: city_code

fields.help_en:
The cross-city city name. Separate multiple values with Chinese commas.
Note: You can specify up to 10 cities. The values of city_code and city_name must correspond one-to-one
fields.help_zh:
跨城城市名称，多值中文逗号分隔
注意：最多传10个城市，city_code和city_name必须一一对应
fields.name: city_name

fields.help_en: The cross-city car service rules. Optional. If specified, cross-city rules are read from the approval form data
fields.help_zh: 用车跨车规则；非必填；填写后，跨城规则读取审批单数据
fields.name: car_city_set

fields.help_en: The user ID of the traveler
fields.name: user_id

fields.help_en:
The car service cities. Separate multiple cities with Chinese commas (，).
Note: You can specify up to 10 cities. The values of city and city_code_set must correspond one-to-one
fields.help_zh:
用车城市，多个城市请用中文“，”隔开。
注意：最多传10个城市，city和city_code_set必须一一对应
fields.name: city

fields.help_en:
The set of city codes for intra-city car service. Separate multiple cities with Chinese commas (，).
Note: 1) Either city_code_set or city is required. If both are specified, city_code_set takes precedence.
You can specify up to 10 cities
fields.help_zh:
市内用车城市code集合，多个城市请用中文“，”隔开。
注意：1)city_code_set和city必填一个，两者都有值默认以city_code_set为准
最多传10个城市
fields.name: city_code_set

fields.help_en: The car service date. Control is applied on a daily basis. For example, a value of 2021-03-18 20:26:56 indicates that the car service is available on 2021-03-18. For cross-day scenarios, use the finished_date parameter together. The time parameter must be in the yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss string format
fields.help_zh: 用车时间，按天管控，比如传值2021-03-18 20:26:56表示2021-03-18当天可用车，跨天情况配合finished_date参数使用（时间参数填写必须为yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss字符串格式）
fields.name: date

fields.help_en: The car service end date. Control is applied on a daily basis. For example, if date is set to 2021-03-18 20:26:56 and finished_date is set to 2021-03-30 20:26:56, the car service is available from 2021-03-18 (inclusive) to 2021-03-30 (inclusive). If this parameter is not specified, the value of date is used as the end date. The time parameter must be in the yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss string format
fields.help_zh: 用车截止时间，按天管控，比如date传值2021-03-18 20:26:56、finished_date传值2021-03-30 20:26:56表示2021-03-18(含)到2021-03-30(含)之间可用车，该参数不传值情况使用date作为用车截止时间；（时间参数填写必须为yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss字符串格式）
fields.name: finished_date

parameters.help_en: The car service date. Control is applied on a daily basis. For example, a value of 2021-03-18 20:26:56 indicates that the car service is available on 2021-03-18. For cross-day scenarios, use the finished_date parameter together. The time parameter must be in the yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss string format
parameters.help_zh: 用车时间，按天管控，比如传值2021-03-18 20:26:56表示2021-03-18当天可用车，跨天情况配合finished_date参数使用（时间参数填写必须为yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss字符串格式）
parameters.name: date

parameters.help_en: The car service end date. Control is applied on a daily basis. For example, if date is set to 2021-03-18 20:26:56 and finished_date is set to 2021-03-30 20:26:56, the car service is available from 2021-03-18 (inclusive) to 2021-03-30 (inclusive). If this parameter is not specified, the value of date is used as the end date. The time parameter must be in the yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss string format
parameters.help_zh: 用车截止时间，按天管控，比如date传值2021-03-18 20:26:56、finished_date传值2021-03-30 20:26:56表示2021-03-18(含)到2021-03-30(含)之间可用车，该参数不传值情况使用date作为用车截止时间；（时间参数填写必须为yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss字符串格式）
parameters.name: finished_date

parameters.help_en:
The third-party invoice header ID associated with the approval form.

<warning>This field is required. To configure it as optional, contact operations.></warning>
parameters.help_zh:
审批单关联的三方发票抬头ID

<warning>该字段必填，如需配置为非必填，请联系运营></warning>
parameters.name: third_part_invoice_id

parameters.help_en:
The third-party cost center ID associated with the approval form.

审批单关联的三方成本中心ID
<warning>该字段必填，如需配置为非必填，请联系运营></warning>
parameters.name: third_part_cost_center_id

parameters.help_en: The project code associated with the approval form
parameters.name: project_code

parameters.help_en: The project name associated with the approval form
parameters.name: project_name

parameters.help_en: The third-party employee ID of the user who initiates the approval
parameters.help_zh: 发起审批的第三方员工ID
parameters.name: user_id

parameters.help_en: A header parameter obtained from the "Enterprise Access Credential" operation (added in the header). In HTTP mode, you can use so_corp_token=value or dtb_corp_token=value in the URL as an alternative
parameters.help_zh: header参数,由“企业访问凭证”接口获取（添加在header里）,http模式可以在链接中使用so_corp_token=value或者dtb_corp_token=value来替代
parameters.name: x_acs_btrip_so_corp_token
